holdout_card.fact_statement: Tameryraptor is known from rock layers of the Bahariya Formation.
holdout_card.source_span: It is known from a partial skeleton collected in rock layers from the Bahariya Formation by crews of German paleontologist Ernst Stromer in 1914

qa_variants.question: From which geological formation's rock layers is Tameryraptor known?
qa_variants.source_span: It is known from a partial skeleton collected in rock layers from the Bahariya Formation by crews of German paleontologist Ernst Stromer in 1914
